AvoDerm® Dog Stews are crafted in small batches and formulated for
healthy skin and coat. Our Chicken & Veggies Recipe in Gravy features
boneless chicken, fresh carrots, green beans, pumpkin and other
vegetables to support healthy digestion. Our special stew recipe has
a delicious gravy that will satisfy even the pickiest dogs.
GUARANTEED ANALYSIS
Crude Protein (min)........................7.0%
Crude Fat (min)..............................2.0%
Crude Fiber (max)..........................2.0%
Moisture (max)..............................84.0%
Ash (max)......................................4.0%
Calcium (min)................................0.20%
Phosphorus (min)..........................0.16%
Omega-6 Fatty Acid* (min).......0.40%
Omega-3 Fatty Acid* (min).......0.10%
*Not recognized as an essential nutrient by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles.
CALORIE CONTENT
Metabolizable Energy (calculated).................................................797 kcal/kg
Metabolizable Energy (calculated).................................................294 kcal/can
INGREDIENTS Chicken Broth, Chicken, Carrots, Green Beans, Pumpkin, Tapioca Starch,
Potato Protein, Tuna, Sunflower Oil, Seaweed, Spinach, Flaxseed Oil, Tricalcium Phosphate,
Salmon Oil, Salt, Guar Gum, Avocado Oil, Sodium Tripolyphosphate, Potassium Chloride,
Inulin, Vitamins (Vitamin E Supplement, Vitamin A Supplement, Niacin Supplement,
D-Calcium Pantothenate, Thiamine Mononitrate, Beta-carotene, Biotin, Riboflavin
Supplement, Vitamin B12 Supplement, Pyridoxine Hydrochloride, Folic Acid), Minerals (Zinc
Oxide, Reduced Iron, Copper Amino Acid Complex, Manganese Sulfate, Sodium Selenite,
Potassium Iodide), Choline Chloride, Magnesium Sulfate, Copper Sulfate.
AvoDerm® Dog Food Stew Chicken & Veggies Recipe in Gravy is formulated to meet the
nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for All Life Stages
including growth of large size dogs (70 lbs or more as an adult).

DAILY FEEDING INSTRUCTIONS
Amount of food your dog requires will depend on activity, age,
environment and breed. Feed at room temperature and refrigerate
unused portion. Adjust feeding to maintain optimum weight. Always
provide access to clean, fresh water.
Feed adult dogs 1/2 - 1 can per 5-10 lbs body weight per day.
Puppies and Gestating/Lactating Dogs (consult your veterinarian):
Feed up to twice as much per pound of body weight as an adult.
100% Satisfaction
Guaranteed!
If for any reason you are dissatisfied with this
product, return the unused portion to your
AvoDerm Natural® dog food retailer along with
your receipt for replacement or refund.
